title: Foodweb guild attributes (16-guild model)
description: Per-guild attribute table for the 16-guild MIMES foodweb model: recruitment + mortality rates, growth bounds, respiration, food intake, light/nutrient limitation flags, nitrogen + carbon ratios, temperature tolerances. Drives the FoodWebDiagram node parameters and the foodweb sub-model's biomass dynamics.
